strategies.name: opening_range_breakout_retest_with_session_bias
strategies.entry_summary: Use the 7:00 a.m. and 8:00 a.m. H1 candles to set directional bias via an engulfing pattern before the New York session: bullish engulfing for longs, bearish engulfing for shorts.
